data.description: Redefining Urban Comfort at Altus by Emaar
data.display_address: Altus, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Altus is a refined residential project by Emaar that beautifully combines modern architecture with the tranquility of nature. Located in the bustling Dubai Creek Harbor, this development offers a unique lifestyle that balances urban vibrancy with serene surroundings.

The project features two stunning towers, one soaring 21 floors and the other standing at 14 floors, offering a variety of 1-3 bedroom apartments. The architectural style of Altus reflects its scenic environment, with expansive windows and private balconies that create seamless transitions between indoor and outdoor living. Inside, residents are greeted by a vision of urban elegance characterized by a minimalist design complemented by luxurious natural materials.

Altus prioritizes well-being, offering a host of amenities aimed at nurturing both body and soul. Residents can engage in fitness activities in the state-of-the-art gym, unwind in the yoga room, or find peace in the dedicated meditation areas. The swimming pool area is designed to provide relaxation while showcasing breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.

Perfectly positioned, Altus offers the best of both worlds: the tranquility of nature and the conveniences of city living. Just a four-minute walk from the metro, residents enjoy easy access to Dubai’s array of attractions. A nearby park provides a peaceful escape, while the vibrant waterfront is home to an enticing selection of restaurants and shops.

Altus is an ideal choice for those looking to embrace a sophisticated lifestyle in a picturesque setting.
